name: Anwen
greeting: It is easier to keep a table than an account. I used to pretend they were the same work.
lines: Kael: The names are still here.
Anwen: Yes. Whatever you think of me, they stay.

actions.label: You can keep doing the work now.

relationship_event.text: Kael helped tidy the shrine and encouraged Anwen to keep doing the work, without erasing her responsibility.
relationship_event.acknowledgement: You said to keep doing the work. I'm here.

actions.label: Care doesn't make concealing those names right.

relationship_event.text: Kael helped with the shrine while explicitly challenging Anwen's concealment. Help did not mean absolution.
relationship_event.acknowledgement: You were right: a clean cloth does not answer for a hidden name. I remember both things you did here.

relationship_event.text: Kael and Anwen shared silence after tidying the shrine. Neither made a promise of forgiveness.
relationship_event.acknowledgement: Thank you for the quiet. I won't put words in it.
